summary_en: Fellow-tech acquired 1,083,273 shares (87.55% of voting rights, excluding treasury stock) in Japan Resistor Manufacturing through a tender offer that closed on November 5, 2026, establishing itself as parent company, major shareholder, and largest shareholder effective November 12, 2026 settlement date. The tender offer succeeded as the number of tendered shares exceeded the minimum threshold of 618,700 shares.
title_en: Notice regarding the results of Japan Resistor Manufacturing's public tender offer by Fellow-tech and changes in parent company, principal shareholders and largest principal shareholder
translation_en_brief:
Fellow-tech Co., Ltd. completed a public tender offer for shares of Japan Resistor Manufacturing Co., Ltd., which commenced on September 18, 2026 and closed on November 5, 2026. The tender offer succeeded as 1,083,273 shares were tendered, exceeding the minimum threshold of 618,700 shares. Upon settlement on November 12, 2026, Fellow-tech will acquire all of the company's shares except treasury stock held by Japan Resistor Manufacturing itself, resulting in voting rights ownership of 87.55% based on issued shares excluding treasury stock as of June 30, 2026 (total issued shares: 1,240,000; treasury stock: 2,797 shares).

As a result of this acquisition, Fellow-tech will become the company's parent company, principal shareholder, and largest shareholder. Fellow-tech is a listed company engaged in the manufacture and sale of semiconductor-related equipment, electronic devices, and automotive-related products, with capital of 29,549 million yen as of March 31, 2026. The disclosure confirms there are no existing capital, personnel, or business relationships between Japan Resistor Manufacturing and Fellow-tech prior to the tender offer.

The company notes that Fellow-tech did not acquire all outstanding shares, as some shares remained untendered. Since Fellow-tech is listed, no unlisted parent company disclosure requirements apply.
